---
title: "moderndive (Python)"
---

The Python companion package for **ModernDive: Statistical Inference via Data
Science**. See the [README](../README.md) for installation and a quick start.

This `doc/` directory is a placeholder for a [quartodoc](https://machow.github.io/quartodoc/)
API site (mirroring [plotnine's docs](https://plotnine.org)). The public API is:

## Inference grammar
`specify`, `hypothesize`, `generate`, `calculate`, `fit`, `observe`, `assume`,
`get_p_value`, `get_confidence_interval`, `visualize`, `shade_p_value`,
`shade_confidence_interval` (plus British/short aliases).

## Theory-based tests
`t_test`, `prop_test`, `chisq_test`, `t_stat`, `chisq_stat`, and the `theory`
module.

## Regression helpers
`get_regression_table`, `get_regression_points`, `tidy_summary`.

## Sampling & plots
`rep_slice_sample`, `rep_sample_n`, `pairplot`.

## Data
`load_*()` loaders and `load_dataset(name)` / `available_datasets()`.
